note: The fuzzer-controlled byte buffer is wrapped as a UA_ByteString and becomes the input to JSON decoding.
The decoded Variant can contain a ByteString whose length is passed into base64 encoding.
The output length is derived from the input length and padding, but the implementation later assumes the produced buffer is fully initialized before it is copied out.
For inputs with one leftover byte, only part of the allocated output is written here and the remaining bytes depend on the exact padding path.
The encoder copies flen bytes from the base64 buffer into the JSON output, reading any bytes that were not initialized by UA_base64.
